comment: Anchor->target proximity pairings (0.53.0). JsPairAnalyzer finds an 'anchor' (a piece of logic) and extracts a concrete 'target' appearing within a proximity window in the same JS body, emitting ONE actionable finding (anchor -> target, try X). Passive/static regex proximity, not taint/AST -- a lead to confirm by hand. Bounded regex (ReDoS). Reported non-sensitive.

pairs.note: this route appears to be gated only in the browser -- request its backing API directly with a low-priv/no session to check server-side authorization

pairs.note: a key/IV/secret is embedded next to client-side crypto -- extract it and decrypt or forge offline (e.g. CyberChef); client-side crypto is not a control
